limitations: These are previously recorded results, not new measurements or acceptance of the v10 source. Earlier detailed records remain in Git history at record_source_revision.
Original logs, verification scripts, source manifests and build artifacts were referenced by local temporary paths; they are not retained in this repository. No persistent artifact URL was recorded.

The tested source snapshots retained two pre-existing uncommitted TVM changes excluded from the PR. Their hashes alone do not reconstruct the exact tested input, so a clean-checkout reproduction is not established.
Two host xfails cover the pre-existing A5 AscendC abs lowering limitation, also reproduced with legacy. The ON skip is the OFF-only diagnostic.
No A2/A5 device execution or all-repository-example acceptance is claimed. Z3 version testing covers the two listed endpoints, not every version in the dependency range.
The Z3 matrix used a temporary verification script whose exact core test selection was not retained; test-suites.json describes the host, device and separate legacy VS suites only.
Compiler installation checks do not establish standalone runtime-only loading. A separate v8 check failed with missing IRBuilderFrameNode RTTI and reproduced on v6.
Performance data is the latest retained v8 measurement of four small kernels, includes host launch gaps and does not establish device-only speedup or Persistent+SIP overhead.
